rationale: EO 10438 (18 FR 1491) transferred the functions of the National Security Resources Board and its Chairman under four named orders to the Director of Defense Mobilization (section 1) and provided for transfer of records and personnel (section 2). EO 10461 (1953) amended references to the Director and Office of Defense Mobilization. Section 604 of EO 11051 (signed 1962-09-27) provides that, to the extent they have not heretofore been made or become inapplicable, the listed orders including Executive Order No. 10438 of March 13, 1953 are hereby superseded and revoked. Every command of EO 10438 was either made, as a self-executing transfer, or was superseded and revoked in 1962, so no operative command remained on 2026-10-14. Recommended status: no.
